title: UploadDeclareRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/uploads (BE-05, #19). The client declares the bytes it is about to send; the server answers with a scoped upload target and verifies size and hash at completion. size_bytes must be positive; the server enforces OVRLY_UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES and answers 413 UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE above it.

size_bytes.description: Exact byte length of the content that will be PUT to the target. Positive.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the content, lowercase hexadecimal. Compared with the stored bytes on completion.

content_type.description: Media type of the content. Optional; the server defaults to application/octet-stream.
